questions.q: 7. In a certain code language, ‘hairs are golden black’ is coded as ‘@ rm pr kt’, ‘golden bells are sound’ is coded as ‘ak @ kt #’, and ‘bells being loud’ is coded as ‘# jm jk’. What can be the code for ‘bell sound’ in that language?
o: ak @
ak #
ak jm
jm jk
questions.s:
7.(b)

From ‘golden bells are sound’ and ‘bells being loud’, we get ‘bells’ = ‘#’

From ‘hairs are golden black’ and ‘golden bells are sound’, we get ‘are golden’ = ‘@kt’

Putting obtained codes in ‘golden bells are sound’, we get ‘sound’ = ‘ak’

Hence, ‘bell sound’ = ‘ak#’

questions.q:
In a certain code language:

L/O/W ---- &*/ @>/ $%
